name: 3 bomen, 6 lenzen (Lens Trees)

surveyed.source: Centroid of the three trunk bases triangulated from bearings in Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas TMX7316010203-000717_pano_0000_000526 (2018-05-14) and TMX7316010203-000224_pano_0000_000767 (2017-03-27), CC BY 4.0; 2.8 m south-east of OSM node 4360169260 (52.3686724, 4.8944688), which stays the POI. Heights scaled to the artist's 700 cm (Commons 'The lens trees.jpg'). See lensbomen-footprints.json.

attribution.title: 3 bomen, 6 lenzen (Thom Puckey, 1989)
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Thom Puckey (1989)
attribution.modifications: Original low-poly reconstruction: three tapered bronze trunks forking into horn-like branches (tapered Bezier tubes) carrying six translucent lenses in steel rims; arrangement and proportions read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and Wikimedia Commons photographs by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0), Michal Klajban (CC BY-SA 3.0) and Thom Puckey (CC BY-SA 4.0), for proportion only. No photo pixels or imported meshes.

poiNote: OSM node n4360169260 (tourism=artwork, artwork_type=sculpture, material=bronze, wikidata Q26453081) stays the POI; nothing is suppressed.
